Feature.risk_justification: 38 repositories get a rename commit of the file every Claude Code and Codex session loads first; four need a hand merge; commit-time hooks in six repos rewrite or lint markdown; the write side runs with per-command sandbox bypass in sibling repos, so a wrong command lands outside the project that owns this task.
Feature.context7_note: no external library is used; the script is Python 3 stdlib (`json`, `os`, `pathlib`, `subprocess`), the rest is `git`, `bd`, `pre-commit`, `codex` CLIs whose behaviour was probed in this session.

Feature.risk_justification: same as Discovery - one PreToolUse deny hook (exit 2) in the global settings of every project on this machine (83 repositories), matchers Bash and EnterWorktree, running in the main conversation and in subagents; a false positive blocks branch and worktree creation machine-wide until fixed. Upward-only escalation keeps high.
Feature.context7_note: stdlib only (json, re, shlex, subprocess, os, datetime, pathlib); no third-party library, so no Context7 lookup applies. Git option spellings were probed with git 2.43.0 in a throwaway repository in this session (`--create=<name>` and glued `-c<name>` are accepted; `git worktree add --orphan <path>` names the branch after the path).
